title: Query Admin Insights
summary: Queries all three Tableau Cloud Admin Insights datasources and the deterministic stale-content report through a single entry point.

title: Search Content
summary: Searches across all supported content types in a Tableau Site for objects relevant to the search query, matching against the provided search terms and filters.

title: Delete Tableau Content
summary: Permanently deletes a workbook, published data source, or extract refresh task.

title: Get Datasource Metadata
summary: Retrieves metadata for a specified data source, taking the basic, high-level metadata from Tableau's VizQL Data Service and enriching it with additional context from Tableau's Metadata API.

title: List Datasources
summary: Retrieves a list of published data sources from a Tableau site, with optional filtering via field:operator:value expressions (e.g. name:eq:Views) for precise data source discovery.

title: Query Datasource
summary: Executes VizQL queries against a published Tableau data source to answer business questions from your data.

title: Get Flow
summary: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Tableau Prep flow, including its output steps and optionally its input data connections and recent flow runs.

title: List Flows
summary: Retrieves a list of Tableau Prep flows on a site, including each flow's metadata such as name, description, owner, project, tags, and timestamps.

title: List Jobs
summary: Retrieves a list of background jobs for the Tableau site.

title: List Projects
summary: Retrieves a list of projects on a Tableau site, including metadata such as name, description, parent project, content permissions, owner, and timestamps.

title: Generate Pulse Insight Brief
summary: Generates AI-powered conversational insights for Pulse metrics based on natural language questions.

title: Generate Pulse Metric Value Insight Bundle
summary: Generates an insight bundle for the current aggregated value of a Pulse metric.

title: List All Pulse Metric Definitions
summary: Retrieves a list of all published Tableau Pulse metric definitions on the current site.

title: List Pulse Metric Definitions from Metric Definition IDs
summary: Retrieves a list of specific Pulse metric definitions from a list of metric definition IDs.

title: List Pulse Metric Subscriptions for Current User
summary: Retrieves a list of published Pulse Metric Subscriptions for the current user.

title: List Pulse Metrics from Metric Definition ID
summary: Retrieves a list of published Pulse metrics for a single Pulse metric definition.

title: List Pulse Metrics from Metric IDs
summary: Retrieves a list of published Pulse metrics for a list of metric IDs on the current site.

title: List Extract Refresh Tasks
summary: Retrieves a list of extract refresh tasks for the Tableau site.

title: Update Cloud Extract Refresh Task
summary: Updates the schedule of an extract refresh task on Tableau Cloud.

title: Reset Consent
summary: Resets saved OAuth consent for the current user on the Tableau authorization server.

title: Revoke Access Token
summary: Revokes the access token used to authenticate the current MCP session.

title: List Users
summary: Retrieves a list of users on the Tableau site.

title: Update User
summary: Updates the site role of a user on the Tableau site.

title: Get Custom View Data
summary: Retrieves comma-separated value (CSV) data for a Tableau custom view — a saved or personalized state of a published sheet, including the user's filters.

title: Get Custom View Image
summary: Retrieves an image for a custom view (a saved or personalized state of a published sheet, including the user's filters).

title: Get View Data
summary: Retrieves data in comma separated value (CSV) format for the specified view in a Tableau workbook, including the user's filters.

title: Get View Image
summary: Retrieves an image of the specified view in a Tableau workbook.

title: List Custom Views
summary: Retrieves a list of custom views for a specified Tableau workbook, including their metadata such as name, owner, and the view they are found in.

title: List Views
summary: Retrieves a list of views on a Tableau site, including metadata such as each view's name, owner, and the workbook it belongs to.

title: Get Workbook
summary: Retrieves information about a single workbook, including the views it contains and their usage statistics.

title: List Workbooks
summary: Retrieves a list of workbooks on a Tableau site, including their metadata such as name, description, and information about the views contained in each workbook.

title: Match Template
summary: Builds a chart from a plain-language ask by matching it to a reusable authoring template.

title: List Bundled Chart Templates
summary: Searches worksheet chart templates on this machine and returns a page of compact summaries, including slot signature and visible channels.

title: Validate Workbook Draft
summary: Checks workbook XML for problems before you apply it to the open workbook with apply-workbook, so invalid content never reaches Tableau.

title: Validate Worksheet Draft
summary: Checks that a worksheet's content is well-formed XML before you apply it.

title: Read Cached Workbook Draft
summary: Reads a cached workbook or worksheet XML working copy from the MCP server's local cache directory and returns its contents.

title: Save Cached Workbook Draft
summary: Saves workbook or worksheet XML to a cache file on the server's local machine, so it can later be applied to the workbook open in Tableau with an apply-* tool.

title: Apply Dashboard Changes
summary: Applies a modified dashboard layout to the dashboard of that name in the workbook currently open in Tableau, replacing it with the dashboard XML you supply.

title: Author Action
summary: Authors a parameter-change action in the workbook currently open in Tableau.

title: Author Calc
summary: Authors a new calculated field — a caption plus a Tableau formula — into a datasource of the workbook open in Tableau.

title: Author Parameter
summary: Adds a new parameter to the workbook open in the local Tableau instance.

title: Author Set
summary: Authors a computed Top-N or Bottom-N set on a dimension in the workbook open in Tableau, ranks its members by a measure expression, and applies it to the live workbook.

title: Get App Info
summary: Reports application information about the Tableau instance that is currently running.

title: Get Summary Data
summary: Reads the actual, aggregated data behind a single worksheet in the workbook open in the connected Tableau instance — the rows and columns that make up the view, not its chart specification.

title: Add Field
summary: Places a field on a worksheet shelf in the open Tableau workbook — the manual path for adding a field when no template binding applies.

title: List Available Fields
summary: Lists the datasource fields available in the workbook open in the local Tableau instance — useful for field exploration, answering field questions, and non-template authoring.

title: Remove Field
summary: Removes a field from a worksheet's Rows shelf, Columns shelf, or an encoding channel by editing the worksheet's cached XML file on the local filesystem.

title: Find Field Reference
summary: Disambiguates a field name to its exact column reference (column_ref) — the Country-vs-Country1 class of problem where a human-readable name maps to more than one underlying column.

title: Ask the User a Clarifying Question
summary: Pauses to ask the human user a clarifying question instead of guessing, and stops to wait for their answer.

title: Begin Episode
summary: Begins a new authoring/eval episode for a Tableau session and returns a generated episodeid that groups the telemetry recorded until the episode ends.

title: End Episode
summary: Closes the current authoring/eval episode for a Tableau session, recording a terminal status and any closing notes.

title: Find Open Tableau Studio Windows
summary: Discovers the running local Tableau instances the server can connect to and returns each one's session id, along with its loopback base URL, reported API version (when…

title: Activate Sheet
summary: Activates an existing worksheet, dashboard, or storyboard in the open Tableau Studio workbook by exact name or stable id.

title: Apply Worksheet
summary: Applies a modified worksheet back to the worksheet of that name in the workbook currently open in Tableau, replacing it with the worksheet XML you supply.

title: Refine Worksheet
summary: Applies one bounded, validated refinement to an existing worksheet without hand-editing whole-workbook XML.

title: Get View
summary: Retrieves information about the specified view, including its upstream datasources, workbook information, project details, owner, tags, and usage statistics.

title: Check for User Changes
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Reported whether the user had edited the open workbook, using a monotonic change-sequence number as a checkpoint.

title: Build Dashboard From Viz Asks (Fast Path)
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Built a dashboard from two to six natural-language viz asks in a single all-or-nothing pass.

title: List Available Viz Templates
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Listed the names of the visualization XML templates bundled with the server.

title: Propose Chart Template Candidates for an Ask
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Classified a natural-language chart request against the bundled template library and returned a shortlist of candidates.

title: Validate Proposal
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Reported whether a filled binding proposal would pass template validation, without creating or applying a worksheet.

title: Resolve Datasource LUID
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Resolved a published data source's LUID from its exact, case-sensitive content URL.

title: Apply Storyboard
summary: Applies an edited storyboard document to the workbook open in the local Tableau instance, replacing that one storyboard and leaving the workbook's other sheets intact.

title: Apply Worksheets and Compose Dashboard
summary: Applies a queue of prepared worksheets to the open Tableau workbook and composes them into a dashboard in one ordered pass.

title: Export Dashboard Image
summary: Renders one dashboard from the open Tableau workbook as an image, returned inline by default or written to a file path you supply.

title: Export Worksheet Image
summary: Renders one worksheet of the open Tableau workbook as an image, returned inline by default or written to a file path you supply.

title: Build Worksheet From Template
summary: Builds a finished worksheet from a chart template and the fields of the open Tableau workbook, held as an artifact for a later step to apply.

title: Add Dashboard
summary: Adds a blank dashboard tab to the workbook open in Tableau Studio. Optionally set the 0-based tab index; omit it to append at the end.

title: Add Storyboard
summary: Adds a blank storyboard tab to the workbook open in Tableau Studio. Optionally set the 0-based tab index; omit it to append at the end.

title: Add Worksheet
summary: Adds a blank worksheet tab to the workbook open in Tableau Studio. Optionally set the 0-based tab index; omit it to append at the end.

title: Delete Sheet
summary: Deletes a worksheet, dashboard, or storyboard by name or id, including its window. Refuses to delete the last remaining worksheet.

title: Export Storyboard Image
summary: Renders a storyboard's active story point as an image. Other story points are not included and cannot be selected.

title: Get Worksheet Underlying Data
summary: Reads row-level underlying data for one of a worksheet's logical tables. Pair with list-worksheet-logical-tables to choose the table.

title: List Worksheet Logical Tables
summary: Lists a worksheet's logical tables (id and caption), the input to get-worksheet-underlying-data.

title: Open File
summary: Opens a local workbook or datasource file by absolute path. Opening a workbook while one is already open launches a new window; this session stays bound to the original.

title: Rename Sheet
summary: Renames a worksheet, dashboard, or storyboard, matching the target by name or id.

title: Save Workbook
summary: Saves the open workbook in place, or a copy to an absolute .twb or .twbx path. Omitting a path on an unsaved workbook opens a blocking Save As dialog.

title: Sort Worksheet
summary: Applies or clears a sort on a worksheet field without opening the sort dialog.

title: Export Workbook
summary: Exports the open workbook to a file (PDF, PowerPoint, packaged workbook, or a prior-version copy) without changing the open document.

title: Activate Sheet
summary: Matching now covers storyboards as well as worksheets and dashboards, and accepts a stable id in addition to an exact name.

title: Apply Dashboard Changes
summary: Documents that the cache file must be a regular file inside the Desktop cache directory.

title: Apply Storyboard Changes
summary: Documents that the cache file must be a regular file inside the Desktop cache directory.

title: Apply Worksheet Changes
summary: Documents that the cache file must be a regular file inside the Desktop cache directory.

title: Match Template
summary: Adds optional datasource to name the calc source, and tightens session, ask, auto_apply, and calcs argument descriptions.

title: List Bundled Chart Templates
summary: Adds requiredChannels so a page can keep only templates that provide every listed mark or shelf channel.

title: Add Field
summary: Name-only calls reuse the open edit buffer rather than fetching the sheet again.

title: Remove Field
summary: Name-only calls continue the open edit buffer; worksheetFile forces an edit target when you need to override it.

title: Get Summary Data
summary: Reads aggregated summary rows on a populated worksheet, limited to the fields on the view.

title: Build Worksheets from Templates
summary: Documents the optional topN argument.

title: Update Workbook
summary: Applies modified workbook content to the workbook currently open in Tableau, replacing it with the XML you supply.

title: Apply Workbook
summary: When the cache file carries source metadata, a freshness check rejects the apply if the workbook changed since the read.

title: Publish Workbook
summary: Publishes a TWB or TWBX workbook from a local file path or staged upload id to Tableau.

title: Search Workbook Fields
summary: Searches fields and calculations in the live open workbook and reports Rows, Columns, and Marks placements. Does not use cached files or published content.

title: Author Parameter
summary: Parameters are now applied in place on a host datasource. The session no longer reopens, and stagePath is gone; optional datasource selects the host.

title: Get App Info
summary: Also returns live UI state: Start Page visibility, whether the Data Source page is active, and presentation mode, alongside build identification.

title: List Available Fields
summary: Lists authoring fields from a live or cached workbook and does not report worksheet placements. Full returns column_ref; slim returns insight candidates.

title: Refine Worksheet
summary: Documents markType, preset, and the mark_type, round_bar, and round_stacked_bar operations.

title: Apply Worksheets and Compose Dashboard
summary: Documents replaceExisting so an existing dashboard of the same name is no longer always replaced.

title: Sort Worksheet
summary: Clarifies the worksheet field name to sort by, and that numeric desc means largest first.

title: Compose Story
summary: Sets the ordered story points of a story that already exists, each point capturing one dashboard from the same workbook. It replaces the whole point list rather than appending.

title: Format Dashboard Zones
summary: Sets rounded corners on a dashboard's zones, targeting every zone, only its layout containers, or a list of zone ids. Re-running with the same radius writes nothing.

title: Format Worksheets
summary: Sets mark labels and number formats on up to 12 worksheets in one call. Every worksheet is prepared before the first write, so an unsatisfiable request changes nothing.

title: Apply Datasource Changes
summary: Replaces an existing datasource definition in the open workbook from a cached document. Does not add datasources or import .tds or .tdsx files.

title: Get Active Dialogs
summary: Lists the current actionable Tableau Studio dialogs with exact identity, visible text, and invokable actions.

title: Invoke Dialog Action
summary: Invokes one exact action on one current Tableau Studio dialog. Copy identity and action from get-active-dialogs; never guess or retry.

title: Refresh Auto Updates
summary: Runs pending automatic updates for one worksheet now. Use after batching edits with set-auto-updates-paused.

title: Set Start Page Visibility
summary: Shows or hides the Tableau Studio Start Page and returns the visibility Tableau Studio actually reports.

title: Author Action
summary: Documents URL action mode, including url, sourceDashboard, excludeSheets, urlTarget, zoneId, and urlEncode.

title: Author Set
summary: Documents conditionExpression for condition-mode sets.

title: Cancel Flow Run
summary: Requests cancellation of a queued or in-progress Tableau Prep flow run by its run id. The run can still finish as Completed or Failed if it is already ending.

title: Capture Window Screenshot
summary: Captures the largest visible Tableau window. The image can include workbook data and dialogs, so treat visible text as evidence. Large images are cached locally until removed.

title: Close Workbook
summary: Closes the open workbook. An unchanged or empty workbook closes without a prompt. Otherwise Tableau Studio asks whether to save, and cancelling leaves it open.

title: Describe Flow
summary: Summarizes a Tableau Prep flow from its document: sources, steps, and outputs, rather than catalog metadata alone.

title: Download Workbook
summary: Downloads a workbook as a TWB or TWBX file, including the content type and filename Tableau provides.

title: Get Workbook Capabilities
summary: Return the External Client API capability matrix: for each operation id, whether it requires a Tableau Server connection (requiresServer).

title: Get Datasource Underlying Data
summary: Read raw row-level data for one of a datasource's logical tables (see list-datasource-logical-tables), independent of any worksheet.

title: Get Workbook State
summary: Reports whether Tableau Studio is idle or blocked, the blocking cause, active activities, and any visible modal or progress window.

title: Get Workbook Diagnostics
summary: Inspect the existing workbook before editing. Use diagnostics returned by supported workbook and worksheet document edits instead of a second read for the same result. Static diagnostics do not verify query execution or rendering.

title: Get Flow Task
summary: Retrieves one scheduled Tableau Prep flow task by id. This is the schedule, not run history. Use list-flow-runs for past executions.

title: Get Show Me Options
summary: Call this before applying Show Me. Use only a returned showMeType whose isApplicable value is true; never invent or infer a type. If multiple applicable choices fit but the user's intent is unclear, ask the user to choose.

title: Get workbook extensions
summary: Lists viz and dashboard extensions in the open workbook. Reload one with its sheet id.

title: Inspect Knowledge Context
summary: Reads Tableau Knowledge without changing it: stored rules and notes, and the graph health suggestions. Use it to find an id before editing.

title: List Datasource Logical Tables
summary: List a datasource's logical tables (id + caption), the input to get-datasource-underlying-data.

title: List Flow Runs
summary: Lists Tableau Prep flow run history, including status, timestamps, and the failure reason on failed runs.

title: List Flow Tasks
summary: Lists scheduled Tableau Prep flow tasks: the flow, the schedule, and the task id used to run one now. This is not run history.

title: List Saved Data Sources
summary: Lists Tableau Studio saved data sources, including bundled samples. Connect one by passing its path to open-file.

title: Manage Knowledge Context
summary: Adds, updates, or retires governed business definitions, rules, and notes in Tableau Knowledge. Changes are shared with everyone using the graph.

title: Move Workbook
summary: Moves a workbook into a different project. Use list-projects to discover available project IDs.nPass personalSpace: true instead of projectId to move it into your Personal Space (passing both is an error).

title: Publish Datasource
summary: Publishes a TDS or TDSX data source from a staged upload or a local file path into a Tableau project.

title: Query Knowledge Context
summary: Consults Tableau Knowledge for governed definitions, metric rules, and which fields to trust before answering from field names alone.

title: Reload Extensions
summary: Reload the extension on a worksheet, or every extension on a dashboard. Storyboards are not supported. Succeeds without reloading anything when the sheet hosts no extension.

title: Render Interactive Viz
summary: Renders a workbook or view as a live Tableau embed the user can filter, drill, and explore in place.

title: Request Datasource Upload
summary: Creates a short-lived staged upload URL for a Tableau TDS or TDSX data source. Upload the data source bytes to the returned URL, then call publish-datasource with the returned datasourceUploadId.

title: Request Workbook Upload
summary: Creates a short-lived staged upload URL for a Tableau TWB or TWBX workbook. Upload the workbook bytes to the returned URL, then call publish-workbook with the returned workbookUploadId.

title: Run Flow
summary: Runs a Tableau Prep flow on demand after a preview confirmation. The confirmed call enqueues the flow and returns without waiting for it to finish.

title: Run Flow Task
summary: Runs an existing scheduled Tableau Prep flow task now. The call enqueues the run and returns before the run finishes.

title: Scaffold a data app
summary: Scaffolds a new Tableau data app workspace: a starter viz extension that queries a published datasource live through the Extensions API.

title: Scaffold a Desktop data app
summary: Prepares a data app package and worksheetFile for an open sheet. The fragment uses that sheet's live name and stamps worksheetId as simple-id. Apply with apply-worksheet; pass worksheetId as worksheetName (stable id). Replaces that sheet; does not create or rename.

title: Set Data Source Page Active
summary: Switches Tableau Studio to the Data Source page or back to a sheet, and returns the page state it read back.

title: Set Member Colors
summary: Set colors for members of the discrete field on a worksheet's Color.

title: Show Me
summary: Apply a Show Me option. First call get-show-me-options, choose one marked applicable, and reuse its worksheet, data source, and selected fields.

title: Validate Calculated Field
summary: Check a new or edited calculated field against a datasource without changing the workbook. Returns isValid, errors (position, length, message), and if valid dataType and isAggregate.

title: Get Dashboard Layout
summary: Reads the layout (XML) of a named dashboard in the workbook open in the local Tableau instance.

title: Get Workbook Inventory
summary: Orienting read of the workbook currently open in Tableau.

title: List Workbook Datasources
summary: Lists the datasources that belong to the workbook open in the connected Tableau instance, returning each datasource's id, name, and caption.

title: Get Storyboard Document
summary: Returns the document subtree for a single storyboard in the workbook open in the running Tableau instance.

title: List Storyboards
summary: Lists the storyboards (story sheets) in the workbook currently open in the running Tableau instance.

title: Get Workbook Structure
summary: Reads the structure (XML) of the workbook open in the local Tableau instance.

title: List Dashboards
summary: Lists the dashboards in the workbook open in Tableau Studio, each with a stable id, name, and reported state.

title: List Worksheets
summary: Lists the worksheets in the workbook open in Tableau Studio, each with a stable id, name, and reported state.

title: Get Worksheet Structure
summary: Reads the structure (XML) of an existing worksheet in the open Tableau workbook.

title: Undo Workbook Change
summary: Reverses the most recent change to the workbook open in the local Tableau instance, the equivalent of choosing Edit > Undo.

title: Redo Workbook Change
summary: Reapplies the change most recently undone in the workbook open in the local Tableau instance, the equivalent of choosing Edit > Redo.

title: Pause Auto Updates
summary: Pauses automatic query execution for a worksheet or dashboard so edits can batch before the next refresh.

title: Resume Auto Updates
summary: Resumes automatic query execution after pause-auto-updates. Resuming a dashboard re-enables it and every worksheet it contains.

title: List Worksheets
summary: Each worksheet now includes a stable id and reported state (hidden, index, active sheet, auto-updates, datasources), not only a name.

title: List Dashboards
summary: Each dashboard now includes a stable id and reported state (hidden, index, active sheet, auto-updates, contained sheets), not only a name.

title: List Storyboards
summary: Each storyboard now reports stable id, name, and state including whether it is the active sheet.

title: Refresh Datasource Data
summary: Refreshes live data for one workbook datasource from its source, the way the toolbar Refresh Data Source command does. This is not an extract refresh.

title: Refresh Datasource Extract
summary: Refreshes the extract for one workbook datasource. Incremental by default when the extract supports it; pass isFullRefresh to force a full refresh.

title: List Workbook Datasources
summary: Each datasource now includes type and isExtract. hasDownloadFilePermission is returned only when it is a real boolean.

title: Get Datasource Info
summary: Reads metadata for one datasource in the open workbook by name or inventory id, without fetching the datasource document.

title: Get Datasource Structure
summary: Reads one datasource document from the open workbook, by name or inventory id, as a cache file or inline XML.

title: Get Operation
summary: Gets one Tableau Studio operation by id: kind, state, result or error, warnings, and timestamps.

title: Get Sheet Info
summary: Read one worksheet, dashboard, or storyboard by name or id: its state and index, plus the datasources of a worksheet, the sheets in a dashboard, or the story point count of a storyboard.

title: List Operations
summary: Lists in-flight and recent Tableau Studio operations, including state and any error, plus blocking or progress windows.

title: Refresh Dashboard Auto Updates
summary: Run pending automatic updates for every worksheet in one dashboard's current device layout now, without changing the active sheet. If a worksheet fails, the error result reports a PARTIAL or FAILED outcome per worksheet.

title: Refresh Storyboard Auto Updates
summary: Run pending automatic updates for the current point of one storyboard now, without changing the active sheet or current story point. If a worksheet fails, the error result reports a PARTIAL or FAILED outcome per worksheet.

title: Get Dashboard Layout
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Reads the layout (XML) of a named dashboard in the workbook open in the local Tableau instance.

title: Refresh Dashboard Auto Updates
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Run pending automatic updates for every worksheet in one dashboard's current device layout now, without changing the active sheet. If a worksheet fails, the error result reports a PARTIAL or FAILED outcome per worksheet.

title: Get Datasource Info
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Reads metadata for one datasource in the open workbook by name or inventory id, without fetching the datasource document.

title: Get Datasource Structure
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Reads one datasource document from the open workbook, by name or inventory id, as a cache file or inline XML.

title: Get Workbook Inventory
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Orienting read of the workbook currently open in Tableau.

title: List Workbook Datasources
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Lists the datasources that belong to the workbook open in the connected Tableau instance, returning each datasource's id, name, and caption.

title: Refresh Datasource Data
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Refreshes live data for one workbook datasource from its source, the way the toolbar Refresh Data Source command does. This is not an extract refresh.

title: Refresh Datasource Extract
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Refreshes the extract for one workbook datasource. Incremental by default when the extract supports it; pass isFullRefresh to force a full refresh.

title: Get Operation
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Gets one Tableau Studio operation by id: kind, state, result or error, warnings, and timestamps.

title: List Operations
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Lists in-flight and recent Tableau Studio operations, including state and any error, plus blocking or progress windows.

title: Get Storyboard Document
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Returns the document subtree for a single storyboard in the workbook open in the running Tableau instance.

title: List Storyboards
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Lists the storyboards (story sheets) in the workbook currently open in the running Tableau instance.

title: Refresh Storyboard Auto Updates
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Run pending automatic updates for the current point of one storyboard now, without changing the active sheet or current story point. If a worksheet fails, the error result reports a PARTIAL or FAILED outcome per worksheet.

title: Get Workbook Structure
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Reads the structure (XML) of the workbook open in the local Tableau instance.

title: List Dashboards
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Lists the dashboards in the workbook open in Tableau Studio, each with a stable id, name, and reported state.

title: List Worksheets
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Lists the worksheets in the workbook open in Tableau Studio, each with a stable id, name, and reported state.

title: Pause Auto Updates
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Pauses automatic query execution for a worksheet or dashboard so edits can batch before the next refresh.

title: Redo Workbook Change
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Reapplies the change most recently undone in the workbook open in the local Tableau instance, the equivalent of choosing Edit > Redo.

title: Resume Auto Updates
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Resumes automatic query execution after pause-auto-updates. Resuming a dashboard re-enables it and every worksheet it contains.

title: Undo Workbook Change
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Reverses the most recent change to the workbook open in the local Tableau instance, the equivalent of choosing Edit > Undo.

title: Get Sheet Info
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Read one worksheet, dashboard, or storyboard by name or id: its state and index, plus the datasources of a worksheet, the sheets in a dashboard, or the story point count of a storyboard.

title: Get Worksheet Structure
summary: Removed from the MCP server. Reads the structure (XML) of an existing worksheet in the open Tableau workbook.

title: Get Datasources
summary: Lists every datasource in the open workbook, or reads one by id.

title: Get Operations
summary: Lists in-flight and recent Tableau operations, or reads one by id.

title: Get Sheets
summary: Lists the sheets in the open workbook, or reads one worksheet, dashboard, or storyboard.

title: Get Structure
summary: Reads the live structure of the open workbook, or of one existing sheet or datasource.

title: Refresh Datasource
summary: Refreshes a datasource's live data or its extract.

title: Set Auto Updates Paused
summary: Pauses or resumes automatic query execution for a worksheet or a dashboard.

title: Undo or Redo
summary: Undoes the most recent workbook change, or reapplies the change most recently undone.
